audio_role: Loud female dance-pop vocal, no voiceover, no sizzle or chewing ASMR. First 6 food lifts cut on the vocal beat. 0.24s flash-montage from 6.57 to 7.54 lands on a drum hit. Long pour 8.24-9.98 and glass offer hold under the chorus without cutting.
can_make: We can make the structure from stills: 6x close lift-and-hold beats made as 4 s AI clips started from a real menu photo of each bite with chopsticks or AI-drawn hand added by the house cast holding still, slight upward lift and sauce gloss added in edit, quick menu-page flash and overhead spread made by Ken Burns push on real photos, final glass-offer made as AI push-in on a photo of a glass over a table photo with Dhoo SUSHI LOUNGE text overlay and the same pop track. We cannot fake the thin dripping sauce strand, wet crunch texture in macro, real drifting smoke, or clear pour stream - AI will smear almonds, roe, crunch and glass refraction.
core: Every bite is picked up and held close to show its wet inside and crunchy top.
dish: Assorted modern sushi bites: crispy rice with chopped salmon, torched salmon nigiri, tuna-wrapped bites, tuna tartare cone with roe, salmon roll with sliced almonds
fits: Small one- or two-bite dishes with a wet top and a crunch top: crispy rice, gunkan, uramaki, hand cones, tataki bites. Not soups, large cuts of meat, pasta, or full plates that need cutting.
hook: In 0-0.9s manicured fingers pinch and lift a glistening crispy rice cube topped with diced orange salmon from a dark stone plate in macro.
needs_camera: Real macro gloss on fish fat and sauce, sauce dripping off a lifted roll in motion, real smoke curling around cold fish, real sake pour with light through the liquid and glass, real fingers pressing soft fish, long unbroken table depth with true blur. Nothing with a talking person or crowd is needed - no faces appear.
people: Hands only. Light-pink manicured female hand picks up bites with fingers, wooden chopsticks lift bites and hold them dripping, server torso out of focus in dark vest places and offers a wine glass in final shot. No faces, no eating, no talking.

why_it_works: You see fingers and chopsticks lift each bite and hold it dripping, so you see wet sauce, orange fat, white rice cross-section and brown crunch in macro. Fast succession shows variety without explaining, smoke and dark background make red tuna and orange salmon stand out, pour and glass signal drink pairing.
